correctness.rationale: Full real-data proof from fixed order-statistic partition and m-term slope count. Global 1-Lipschitz sample gradients and strong monotonic average yield the stated W2 bound. Complete P2 Wasserstein contraction gives invariant uniqueness and rate; two-point optimal-transport witnesses attain q for every k and eta; absorbing-state and singular Bernoulli-vs-Lebesgue examples prove the limitations. The actual standalone exact-rational checker passed 282876 interval/endpoint comparisons, 272 sharp examples and 289 absorbing examples; no extrapolation of tests to infinite statements.

originality.rationale: Merad–Gaïffas arXiv:2309.17316 uses diffuse-noise hypotheses to prove Markov-chain ergodicity rather than the sharp atomic empirical-rank W2 bound; Shulgin–Richtárik arXiv:2412.19916 derives descent/bias bounds rather than exact median-rank contraction. Andrew et al arXiv:1905.03871 track private quantiles, and Koloskova et al arXiv:2305.01588 study fixed clipping. The checked mathematical-record summaries had no implication of the derived joint claim; the closest general contraction ingredients do not provide its sharp quantile-dependent coefficient without the new slope count.
residual_risks: Semantic record search and inspected sources are not a completeness proof for all literature or unpublished results.
A possible unindexed analysis of exact empirical quantile clipping might already derive equivalent strong monotonicity or Wasserstein contraction constants.
The Bernoulli affine map and transport coupling are classical; originality is restricted to their quantitative synthesis with the sharp empirical quantile rank theorem.

value.rationale: Exact empirical quantiles are a natural finite-data idealization of adaptive clipping, and the majority rank controls a sharp universal stability threshold for any sample values, including repeated observations. The stepsize boundary is attained rather than merely sufficient. At the median and below, nonunique absorbing invariant measures may occur; above it, W2 convergence can coexist with complete failure of finite-time total-variation mixing. These are substantive design and interpretation boundaries, not restatements of bias estimates.
